cards.example_en: The kitten likes to hide behind the living room curtains.
cards.example_zh: 小猫喜欢躲在客厅的窗帘后面。

cards.example_en: The high shelf in the kitchen is hard to reach.
cards.example_zh: 厨房里那层高架子很难够到。

cards.example_en: We hike in the hills every spring.
cards.example_zh: 我们每年春天去山里远足。

cards.example_en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill outside town.
cards.example_zh: 我们推着自行车爬上镇外那座陡峭的小山。

cards.example_en: I gave him my phone number.
cards.example_zh: 我把电话号码给了他。

cards.example_en: He fixed the bike himself.
cards.example_zh: 他自己修好了自行车。

cards.example_en: His room is clean and bright.
cards.example_zh: 他的房间干净又明亮。

cards.example_en: History club meets in room twelve on Wednesday afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 历史社团星期三下午在十二号教室活动。

cards.example_en: A fast ball can hit the window beside the gym.
cards.example_zh: 飞快的球可能会打到体育馆旁边的窗户。

cards.example_en: My hobby is collecting stamps.
cards.example_zh: 我的爱好是集邮。

cards.example_en: Hold the rope tightly while you cross the stream.
cards.example_zh: 过小溪的时候要紧紧抓住绳子。

cards.example_en: A hole in the tent let rain drip onto my sleeping bag.
cards.example_zh: 帐篷上有个洞，雨水滴到了我的睡袋上。

cards.example_en: Where are you going on holiday?
cards.example_zh: 您要去哪里度假？

cards.example_en: The rain started just as we reached home from practice.
cards.example_zh: 我们训练完刚到家，雨就下起来了。

cards.example_en: I miss the food from my hometown.
cards.example_zh: 我想念家乡的食物。

cards.example_en: Finish your homework before you play.
cards.example_zh: 先完成作业再玩。

cards.example_en: Please be honest with me if you broke the window.
cards.example_zh: 如果是你打碎了窗户，请对我说实话。

cards.example_en: She spooned honey over warm bread at breakfast time.
cards.example_zh: 早饭时她把蜂蜜舀到热面包上。

cards.example_en: Carrying the flag was an honour for the whole class.
cards.example_zh: 举旗是全班的荣誉。

cards.example_en: I hope the rain stops before our family picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我希望家庭野餐开始前雨能停。

cards.example_en: A tired horse drank from the bucket beside the stable.
cards.example_zh: 一匹疲惫的马在马厩旁边的桶里喝水。

cards.example_en: The ambulance took him to hospital after the match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束后，救护车把他送去了医院。

cards.example_en: Our school will host the city basketball final.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校将主办全市篮球决赛。

cards.example_en: The hostess welcomed us into the hall.
cards.example_zh: 女主人欢迎我们进入大厅。

cards.example_en: The soup was too hot to drink at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭的汤太烫了，没法马上喝。

cards.example_en: Our hotel room faced the sea and smelled of salt.
cards.example_zh: 我们的旅馆房间面向大海，有咸咸的味道。

cards.example_en: Homework took an hour after I got back from chess club.
cards.example_zh: 我从象棋社团回来后，作业花了一个小时。

cards.example_en: Smoke rose from the house at the end of our street.
cards.example_zh: 烟从我们这条街尽头的房子里冒了出来。

cards.example_en: We share the housework at weekends.
cards.example_zh: 周末我们分担家务。

cards.example_en: How do you go to school?
cards.example_zh: 你怎么去学校？

cards.example_en: It looked easy; however, it was hard.
cards.example_zh: 看起来容易；然而其实很难。

cards.example_en: Mum gave me a hug before the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前妈妈拥抱了我。

cards.example_en: They saw a huge ship.
cards.example_zh: 他们看到了一艘巨大的船。

cards.example_en: Human babies need care from their parents for years.
cards.example_zh: 人类的婴儿需要父母照顾很多年。

cards.example_en: His humour made the class laugh.
cards.example_zh: 他的幽默逗笑了全班。

cards.example_en: I felt hungry after the long football match.
cards.example_zh: 踢完那场很长的足球赛后，我感到很饿。

cards.example_en: We hunt for clues in the reading passage.
cards.example_zh: 我们在阅读文章里寻找线索。

cards.example_en: Hurry to the school gate or you will miss the bus.
cards.example_zh: 赶快跑到校门口，不然你会错过公交车。

cards.example_en: Tight shoes can hurt your feet on a long walk.
cards.example_zh: 鞋子太紧，走长路会把脚弄疼。

cards.example_en: Her husband met the children at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 她丈夫在学校大门口接孩子。

cards.example_en: I love reading story books.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢读故事书。

cards.example_en: Thin ice covered the pond, so we stayed on the path.
cards.example_zh: 池塘结了薄冰，所以我们只走小路。

cards.example_en: I bought an ice cream after the game.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束后我买了一个冰淇淋。

cards.example_en: Sam had an idea for fixing the broken classroom clock.
cards.example_zh: 萨姆想到一个办法来修坏掉的教室时钟。

cards.example_en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

cards.example_en: Tom stayed home because he felt ill this morning.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆今早病了，所以留在家里。

cards.example_en: A stomach illness kept Nora home during the school play.
cards.example_zh: 一场胃病让诺拉在学校演出期间待在家里。

cards.example_en: Imagine a quiet beach during the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 想象一下暑假里那片安静的海滩。

cards.example_en: I think that it is important that students organize their thoughts before speaking.
cards.example_zh: 我认为学生在说话之前整理自己的想法是很重要的。

cards.example_en: Finishing the puzzle in one minute seemed impossible.
cards.example_zh: 一分钟内拼完这幅拼图似乎不可能。

word.example_en: Hold on, I will open the door.
An accident may hold up the train.
They can hold out until sunset.
Hold on to the rail on the stairs.
word.example_zh: 在楼梯上抓住栏杆不放。

word.example_en: They do homework in the study room.
A cup was named in honour of the poet.
word.example_zh: 一只奖杯以诗人的名字命名，为向他致敬。

word.example_en: I have an idea for the poster.
